Find us

Torstraße 101, 10119 Berlin

A former print works in Mitte, one floor up. Daylight until the early evening, blackout blinds when the shoot wants the dark instead. U-Bahn Rosenthaler Platz is four minutes on foot.

  • Daylight hall180 m², 5 m ceilings
  • Cyclorama6 m, repainted weekly
  • Lighting kitProfoto + Aputure, included
  • Backdrops14 paper rolls + canvas
  • Also on siteMake-up room, kitchen, freight lift

Asked, answered

Yes — regularly across Germany and twice a year further out. Travel is charged at cost and agreed in writing before the shoot; the rates on this page never change because of a postcode.
Proofs land in your online gallery within 48 hours. The final edited set follows within ten working days — or in 24 hours with the rush add-on in the calculator.
You receive full usage rights for the channels we agree in the booking — print, web, social, advertising. We keep the right to show the work in this portfolio, and we never sell your pictures to anyone else.
One reschedule is free up to 14 days before the shoot — life happens. Inside 14 days we charge 20% of the package, and the new date is locked in the same conversation.
